name: Fraechnat

attributes.attribute: a romantic hero who loves Finnabair
the most handsome man in Ireland
set the bride-price of the red-eared cows

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The source for the hero Fráech tells a story of love. His other names are Fraoch, Fraich, and Fróeach. He loved Finnabair, the daughter of the ruler named Medb. Through his mother, the goddess Bébinn, he was partly divine. He stood out as the island's most handsome man. At the court at Cruachan he was known before he arrived. The maid grew fond of him by hearsay and fonder at their meeting. She handed him a ring from her father Ailill. The man asked for the red-eared cows of the maid's mother. The hero endured many trials and a dragon, then won her hand.

okr.objective: Fráech is the romantic hero who wins the hand of Finnabair.
key_results: Fráech was the son of the goddess Bébinn.
